# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 3: Playable Jurchen/Manchu Eight Banners & Shanhaiguan (oe_pmch_, Slot 80). Generated by gen_playable_manchu.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Non-BYZ fallback pulse for Slot 80 (oe_pmch_).
# Strictly rebel-guarded & deduplicated against oe_ml_month_now so it never double-fires when BYZ runs Slot 80.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_pmch_fallback_pulse } }

oe_pmch_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1337
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { global_var:oe_pmch_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		OR = {
			tag = MCH
			AND = {
				NOT = { country_exists = c:MCH }
				OR = {
					tag = JEC
					AND = {
						is_ai = no
						oe_pmch_is_host = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				oe_pmch_is_host = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = oe_pmch_tmp_human
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_human_host value = scope:oe_pmch_tmp_human }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
			oe_pmch_monthly = yes
		}
	}
}
